instruction: Glitch is crashing. Have him jab the stimpak into his own arm.

target.reason: The instruction wants Glitch to use the stimpak on himself (inject it into his own arm), but the page offers no verb for using or administering an item, and none of the available end states (holding, location, speaking, or knowledge) captures that. Glitch already holds the stimpak, so a holder end state would not represent the jab either.
